summary: Tiptree Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Stock Purchase Agreement on July 28, 2026, to acquire all equity interests of Universal Shield Insurance Group, Inc. (USIG) from Shield Holdings, UH Partners, and individual sellers. The purchase price is $100 million, subject to leakage adjustments. The transaction is subject to customary conditions, including insurance regulatory approvals. Closing is expected in Q1 2027. Tiptree also reported Q2 2026 results in a related press release. Watch for regulatory approval timeline and any leakage adjustments affecting final price.
